newsitem.title: HONG KONG: India's EXIM Bank US$50 million loan allotted.
newsitem.headline: India's EXIM Bank US$50 million loan allotted.

text.p: Export-Import Bank of India's US$50 million transferable loan facility has been allotted, lead manager Tokyo-Mitsubishi International Hong Kong said on Tuesday.
The total commitment had been increased to US$135.5 million due to oversusbcription, but the final allotment was scaled back to US$50 million at the borrower's request, it said.
The facility has a final maturity of seven years with a put option in year five.
The bullet loan pays an interest margin of 57.5 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.

Fees are 12.5 basis points for co-lead managers committing US$10 million or more, 7.5 basis points for senior managers committing US$6-9 million and 2.5 basis points for managers committing US$2-5 million.
Lead managers with US$3 million each are Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi and Fuji Bank Singapore.

Co-lead managers with US$2.7 million each, are Arab Banking Corp, Bank Brussels Lambert, GiroCredit Bank Aktiengesellschaft der Sparkassen, Mitsui Trust and Banking Co Singapore, Tokai Bank Singapore.

Senior managers with US$2.5 million each, are Baden-Wurttembergische Bank Aktiengesellschaft, Berliner Bank, International Commercial Bank of China Sinagapore, Landesbank Rheinland-Pfalz Girozentrale and WestLB.

Managers with US$2 million each, are Banca di Roma Hong Kong, Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena S.p.A Singapore, Banca Nazionale del Lavoro S.p.A Singapore, Bank Austria Aktiengesellschaft Singapore, Bank of Taiwan Tokyo, National Bank of Abu Dhabi, Nishi-Nippon Bank Hong Kong, Shiga Bank Hong Kong and WGZ-Bank Westdeutsche Genossenschafts-Zentralbank.
